title: QiSens, the full default pipeline with B zero shot (YOLO26 x on GPU0, Qwen3 VL 8B on GPU1, VLM 3 s windows, 2 frames, 4 slots), 3 repeats with the GT
model: YOLO26 x pose; engine_b/w10-engine-b-v1.pt; SigLIP 2 so400m patch14 384; Qwen3 VL 8B Instruct Q4_K_M

rows.note: differs between repeats; min and max to follow

findings: Headline: the full default pipeline runs in 270.62 s median (270.28 to 270.96) on the 9.9 min QiSens video, under the 300 s gate, with 92.97 / 100 / 100,100,100 / MAE 8.37 s frame accuracy (target 85).
The eval differs between the repeats (VLM outputs are not fully deterministic with parallel slots); min, median and max are to be added.
The VLM setting chosen on public data (3 s, 2 frames, 4 slots) keeps the accuracy of the 2 s, 4 frame run (93.20, w11-qisens-zero-shot).
conclusion: B zero shot meets both critical gates on QiSens: 92.97 frame accuracy and 270.62 s for the full run.
